title: FIPS probe uses throw-away fd: REQUIRE_FIPS side-effects not applied to g_crypto2dev_fd
description: wc_crypto2dev_init (port.c:1386) opens a separate fips_probe_fd, issues CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_REQUIRE_FIPS on it, then closes it. If REQUIRE_FIPS is a query-only ioctl (check if FIPS is available) the extra fd is just wasteful. But if REQUIRE_FIPS configures the fd for FIPS-only operation (as its name suggests), the side-effect applies to the throw-away fd, not to g_crypto2dev_fd. g_crypto2dev_fd would then be used for all ECDSA operations without FIPS enforcement — defeating the purpose of WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_REQUIRE_FIPS. No comment explains why a separate fd is used instead of g_crypto2dev_fd directly. Kernel driver semantics are not documented in-tree.
